Name: Drag To Ship - Updated
Author: Deadwolf929
Description:
This mod allows players to click, and drag their mouse over items they want to add to the "Shipping Bin".
instead of having to individually click each item you would like to sell, you can now hold your left mouse click
and it will automatically add whatever item you move your mouse over. 


[b]NOTE 1[/b]: This mod works for any UI Scaling / Zoom combination between these values:
UI Scaling: 45% - 100%
Zoom Scaling: 50% - 100%

[b]NOTE 2[/b]: It will not add to the "Shipping Bin", tools such as: Galaxy Items, Axes, Pickaxes, Hoes, Etc.

[b]Note 3[/b]: It will sell full stacks of items, if you want to sell 1 of 1 item and keep the rest of the stack
this mechanic has not been changed. Use right click as normal.


[b]
